hero.ability1: Hollow Mirror: Once during your turn, you may spend 3 Lifeforce to copy a Hero's Ability. You keep that Ability until you copy another. Use it as if it were your own.
hero.ability2: Assimilate the Flesh: Once during your turn, you may spend 5 Lifeforce to gain control of target enemy Minion with a Cost of 5 or less. If it dies or is Dismissed, return it to its owner's field, or to their Graveyard if their field is full.
hero.ability3: Devour the Spark: Once during your turn, if you control no Minions, target an enemy Minion and Summon from your Deck a Minion with the same Cost, paying that Cost.
hero.ability4: Twisted Form: Once during your turn, you may spend half the Lifeforce cost (rounded up) of a Minion you control to Dismiss it. If you do, Summon from your Deck a different Minion with a Lifeforce either 1 higher or 1 lower than the Dismissed Minion.
